policy: Refinement after Core v1; experimental gaps do not prevent transition. Reprioritize by user value and available sources.

P1.acceptance: Authorized/source-located records, exact tradition selection and representative input-to-reading tests; no copied textbook text.
Resolve fortification, radix/world-revolution, nodes/lunation and prohibition exceptions; independently verified eligible/rejected examples. Keep experimental until then.
Match published dates and lower-level bond/parent boundaries; preserve named profile and source discrepancies.

P1.work: Fresh runtime/time-data validation and packaging review before distribution
P1.acceptance: Revalidate any dependency/tzdata update; preserve complete notices; assess kernel and binary distribution rights for the intended package. No automatic upgrades.

P2.work: Ancient/Egyptian/historical civil calendars and extended ephemeris range
P2.acceptance: Named calendar/time conventions and independent historical fixtures; no silent approximations.

P2.work: Obscure dignity transmissions, qualitative releasing substitutions, primary directions and wider electional categories
P2.acceptance: Only after source/ROI review; independently test any advertised procedure.

P2.work: Formal event-search completeness, near-polar geometry and observed heliacal visibility
P2.acceptance: Bound domain explicitly, benchmark independent adversarial cases; preserve no-fallback errors.

P2.work: Optional UI, semantic retrieval and expanded security/vulnerability automation
P2.acceptance: Only when it improves practical use; no prerequisite framework for the next technique.

unchanged_limits: Symbolic historical procedures are not empirically validated personal predictions.
Hand/Arroyo/Shea/Brennan and modern Valens translations require their own ingestion/redistribution rights.
Source/local Core v1 Ready is not a binary-distribution or commercial legal certification.
